entries.title: All over the World
entries.summary: Play Deer Simulator in up to 5 sick new languages never seen before. This is the final update from Nugetinc. Time to move on to the next Solid Steel Game.
entries.technical: Deer Simulator languages have been QUADRUPLED!! Very exciting news for all the 82 downloads of Deer Simulator 3D. An option to turn off the Pixel Filter has also been added if you didnt like the main artstyle of the game... The UI has been redesigned for better readability on smaller screens (👀). The leaderboard has been opensourced on github. Please tinker with it and exploit my security and decimate the servers (all hosted elsewhere go mad). Lots of bugs regarding the boss, Treetops, have been fixed. This update is VERY important, as it is the departure of the dearly praised and loved nuget. Very sad. :( This means something new is about to be started at Solid Steel Games. Please hold. I can also imagine the EoL for Deer Simulator updates will be coming within the next couple of months. Thanks for Simulating Deer with us. (1/11/26, Nugetinc.)

changes.text: Added option to turn off pixel filter
Added English, Bulgarian, Polish, Sinhala, Romanian
Improved the UI for better mobile support
The scene would change before the boss finished death and would cause a crash when changing to the victory screen
